messages.content:
SYSTEM items:
[0] Teletext functionality will be skipped and not used in the project.
[1] The target age range is sixteen to forty.
[2] We should have two different groups of functions: simple for the general public and advanced for younger users.
[3] The extra advanced options should be on the onscreen display.
[4] The screen should be placed on the top.

GOLD items:
[0] Include an LCD screen and speech recognition.
[1] Access less-used advanced functions, including audio settings, screen settings and channel programming, through the LCD menu; retain direct controls for basic functions.
[2] Target approximately ages 16-40, following management's below-40 direction and the age range covered by the research.
[3] Exclude teletext under the new management requirements.
[4] Restrict the remote to television control, superseding the provisional television-and-video scope.
[5] Include the corporate logo and corporate colours in the remote's design.
[6] Place the LCD at the top and favor a top-position microphone, leaving detailed placement to the designer.
[7] Use LEDs under the buttons to show which controls are active in the current mode.
